Opening Builder — the OPENING product, reading THE library. The three parts are the ones a profile catalogue names: a frame fixed to the building, a sash moving inside it, and glazing inserted into the sash (VEKA, §2.4). The drawing is a true-scale cut you can switch between PLAN (through the jambs) and SECTION (through head and sill) — one painter, two axis maps, so the two can never drift apart. Punched openings only — a plane within a plane. A curtain wall is the whole plane, so it is a WALL and belongs to the Assembly Builder (§2.4h.1). Pick an opening, switch the list to Materials and click a wood, metal or plastic to assign it to the armed part. FIRST PASS: solid blanks. Chambers, seals, glazing beads and reinforcement are the second pass.

About the costs and the U-values on this page

Costs are indicative unit rates from the material library — supply, install, P&O and tax exactly as the Assembly Builder folds them — and are not a quotation.

Ug — EN 673:2011, the method read from the standard itself: gas conduction with convection (Nusselt), plus radiation between the two surfaces bounding each gas space, at the declared 283 K mean. Surface films: Ug uses EN 673's own (h_e 23, h_i 3.6 + 4.4ε/0.837, from LBNL's EN 673 procedure); the frame keeps Rse 0.04 / Rsi 0.13 (ISO 6946 / 10077-2, the PHI/BC THERM procedure). Flagged proxies: the gas data are ISO 15099's (via LBNL), not EN 673's own table; the 15 K temperature difference is recalled, not read; soft-coat emissivities are typical values; the gas fill is assumed.

Uf — NOT yet ISO 10077-2. It is read one-dimensionally, straight through the frame's depth. A certified Uf is a 2-D solve with the glazing replaced by a λ 0.035 panel; that is the next step here.

Uw — ISO 10077-1 area weighting, WITHOUT Ψg (the spacer's edge loss) or Ψinstall, both of which PHPP adds. So Uw is not a bound in either direction: the missing Ψg would raise it, and the 1-D Uf may err either way. fRsi (condensation) is not computed yet.

Use these numbers to compare rows and to test the method against the certified values shown beside them — never as a declared performance value.
One painter, two cuts. Plan and Section are the same part list drawn through a different axis map — across runs along the opening, through runs the construction depth, and only the mapping to screen changes. The Section Builder arc found the opposite shape (§7b: one rule, two places, is three) when a third engine kept a retired rule for a day. Two views from one part list is that finding applied ahead of time.
A curtain wall is not an opening. An opening is a plane within a plane — four vertices, four edges, one surface, punched through a host. A curtain wall IS the plane, so it is specified as a Wall and built in the Assembly Builder, which already carries mullion spacing, component layers, battens as pressure plates, 2x and 3x glazing, the 1000 mm run rule and corner detailing from the Section Builder. The seed already has `wa_2x_glazed_curtain_wall` and `wa_3x_glazed_curtain_wall` as Wall-class assemblies. Andy's ruling, 2026-09-22 — the singleton is the exception, and it lives on the other side of the seam.
Why the sash face can be zero. A fixed light glazes straight into the frame. Rather than a second dial that can disagree with the drawing, a 0 mm sash face IS the statement — the painter draws no sash and the fold puts the glass line at the frame. One number, one meaning, nothing to keep in sync.
What the material filter is, and the seed problem it exposed. The Materials list offers 06 wood · 05 metals · 08 openings · 07 thermal plus an explicit plastics list. That last part is a finding, not a design: pvc is filed under 09 finishes in materials.json, beside carpet and marble — so a category rule alone would either drop the commonest window frame material in Europe or drag flooring in with it.
The names this page does NOT draw yet — recorded so they are not re-derived. From the double-hung anatomy: the sash is stiles and rails (drawn, and now labelled), divided by muntins (not drawn). The installation family is the whole second group — casing · stop · blind stop · parting bead · stool · apron · drip cap · sub-sill — and every one of them belongs to the junction with the HOST WALL, not to the unit. That is the boundary §2.4 drew between the opening PRODUCT and the rough opening the wall tool cuts, and it is why none of them is a missing field here.
First pass draws solid blanks. The profile in a real catalogue is a chambered extrusion with gaskets, a glazing bead and steel or glass-fibre reinforcement. This page draws the blank — the 92 × 78 stick the profile is milled from — because the fold only needs the blank to be right. Chambers change Uf and nothing else on this screen, which is exactly why they are a second pass and not a blocker.
